title: A question to the owner stands on its own

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: The question meets nearly every criterion: it states the task plainly, explains why it is asking (an unfinished change from another thread overlaps with this task), names a recommended option and says what happens by default.
Each option says what will happen: one change to review, waiting until the other work is merged, or a conflict where one change gets dropped.
It contains no ids, pull request numbers or branch names. It is about 115 words, just under the 120-word limit.
Minor slip: 'main line', 'merged' and 'the other closes' are light version-control jargon used without explanation, and 'one gets dropped' is vague about which work is lost.
